item.title: YOLO Classifier - AI Deciding 'Can I Do This?'
item.description: A deep dive into Claude Code's YOLO classifier mechanism: how AI autonomously judges operation safety, two-stage review process, safety whitelist and rejection tracking, and intelligent permission control in Auto mode.

item.title: Permission System——Installing a "Safety Brake" for AI
item.description: Deep dive into Claude Code's permission system: three-tier permission architecture, YOLO classifier automatic judgment, and Always Allow/Deny rules. Unveiling how AI stops itself before executing rm -rf /, and how production-grade safety control is implemented.
